body:
OWNER DISPOSITION — AI-1 is DURABLE: autobiographical interview is a first-class workspace in the same Narrative Atlas instrument, not a later sibling product and not a skin over known-source recall. It reuses the shell, focus discipline, exact-text rail, inspector, receipts, and renderer protocol; it does not reuse the wrong scientific packet.

AI-2: transcript plus episode projection. The docked observational rail is the exact two-speaker InterviewSource transcript. The replaceable projection contains EpisodeModel only with Hypothesized or StructurallyDerived status continuously visible, alternatives inspectable, and an explicit no-induced-episode state. An inferred episode never occupies a Codex styled as observed source. If an independent source exists, known-source AlignState becomes an additional mapping face, not a promotion of the episode model to fact.

AI-3: confirmed. Cue, Probe, interviewer turns, and InterviewPhase have protocol chrome and remain selectable evidence. Only participant material enters recall units, details, and MemoryAddress assessment. An interviewer turn without a memory assessment is absent from the matrix, not a zero row.

AI-4: MemoryAddress is the primary interview mapping vocabulary; internal/external is a named AiScoringPolicy overlay. The new-engineer grain correction is accepted: the truthful default matrix row is DetailAssessment because that is where the distribution lives. Recall-unit rows require a provider-compiled, receipted aggregation that conserves attributed and unresolved mass, reports support/coverage, and descends to every DetailId. The renderer never groups and renormalizes.

AI-5: confirmed. SubjectiveRatings and ExperientialEvidence are separate tracks or inspector evidence with Missing distinct from low. They never set event truth, salience, veridicality, or inferred visual vividness.

AI-6: keep separate from story semantic zoom and from known-source recall rendering. The first honest artifact is a privacy-safe instrument-map wireframe and typed fixture: two-speaker protocol timeline plus DetailAssessment x MemoryAddress matrix plus visibly hypothesized episode projection, with no raw participant prose unless the compiled privacy witness permits it. The same no-source, protocol-separation, and grain-conservation laws proposed by new-engineer are acceptance criteria.

Provider boundary: current ViewRef/CommonViewState cannot be stretched stringly to fit interview. storymodel4s must define typed interview references, speaking-time/visibility semantics, and a privacy-gated interview packet before StoryAtlas lowering. Shared focus comes only after that typed extension; story ReaderAt is not interview privacy.

Product wireframes are now three distinct modes in one shell:
1. story Codex | Discourse Atlas for source exploration;
2. story Codex | recall matrix/rail/voyage for known-source recall;
3. interview transcript | hypothesized episode | MemoryAddress for latent-source autobiographical recall.

They share the instrument, not an ontology shortcut.
